request: Build merged HMAC+Tunnel Vault integration branch inside existing parent repo worktree; do not alter running Vault or secrets.

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
p=/home/admin1/projects/libral-vault
w="$p/.worktrees/hmac-tunnel-api-20261017"
target=05c3819a049834e36654ddc29cf10133b49dd3f2
test "$(git -C "$p" rev-parse HEAD)" = 4edc99cea3eb56d497b0386ec32d0932b9359128
if [ -d "$w" ]; then test "$(git -C "$w" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$target"; else
 mkdir -p "$p/.worktrees"
 git -C "$p" fetch --no-tags origin "$target"
 git -C "$p" worktree add --detach "$w" "$target"
fi
docker build --target build -t gace-vault-hmac-tunnel-compile:20261017 "$w" >/dev/null
printf 'VAULT_HMAC_TUNNEL_BUILD=PASS\nCOMMIT=%s\n' "$target"

chat_decision_checkpoint.source_evidence: GitHub integration PR9 merged tree SHA05c3819, mergeable true, maintains HMAC and API-only Tunnel; compile inside Vault parent nested worktree without touching active branch/containers.
